subject.title: Control UI: tool calls render as opaque JSON cards — no diffs, no purpose, unpaired parallel calls

question: Should the source-reproducible pairing and deterministic rendering work be split from the proposed model-backed `chat.toolTitles` RPC and per-agent cache?
rationale: The pairing defects have a bounded fix in existing Control UI owners, while title generation creates independent privacy, billing, gateway API, provider-routing, and persistence policy that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Split deterministic and AI scope
options.body: Implement pairing, semantic rows, summaries, and available diffs first, then review generated titles as a separate proposal with explicit safeguards.

options.title: Approve the complete design
options.body: Authorize the UI changes together with a new gateway RPC, fallback-model policy, billing behavior, and per-agent cache.

options.title: Repair pairing only
options.body: Correct call/result association while retaining the current generic activity-card presentation.

recommendation.title: Split deterministic and AI scope
recommendation.body: Implement pairing, semantic rows, summaries, and available diffs first, then review generated titles as a separate proposal with explicit safeguards.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the grouped and collapsed tool-activity design that this request proposes to extend.
